codeReview.summary: Well-structured implementation of entity detail page with proper component separation. Code follows project conventions (biome.json: tabs, single quotes, no semicolons). All expected behaviors are implemented: entity header with truncated ID/status/timestamps, triples panel with value type badges, relations panel with tab switching and navigation, and comprehensive error/loading states.

issues.description: Local truncateEntityId function duplicates functionality of TruncateId component. Consider reusing the shared TruncateId component for consistency, though reference values intentionally don't need copy button functionality.
Same as above - local truncateEntityId function with different default maxLength (12 vs 16 in triples-panel vs 8 in TruncateId component). Minor inconsistency but not blocking.

summary: Entity detail page implementation passes review. All feature requirements met: entity header displays id/status/timestamps, triples panel shows all properties with type badges, relations panel supports outgoing/incoming tabs with clickable entity links, loading/404/error states are properly handled. Worker followed skill procedure correctly. Tests cover all major scenarios (33 tests added across 3 test files). Two minor non-blocking observations about local truncateEntityId functions duplicating TruncateId component logic, but this is acceptable given the different UX needs (no copy button for inline entity IDs).
